section_2_design_test.part1_verdict: NOT CLOSE, and largely UNSHOWN. 9 of 10 axes cannot be scored. The single scoreable axis scores FAIL at f = 0.00. The axis the entire design claim rests on (pectoral fin length / SL) cannot be scored, and for two independent reasons at once.

joint.preregistered_consequence: PREREG rule 1: far AND fails means drop the claim outright.
but_read_this_with_the_qualifications: the two design violations are one fact (body size against a single reference specimen), and the real animal is untestable on those rows by construction
the real flying fish ALSO FAILS the gate (E3, by a factor of 29), so "FAILS" does not separate the design from the target
18 of 21 rows are cannot-evaluate on the design, so the gate is weak and its FAILS verdict carries little information either way
Part 1 is better described as UNSHOWN than as far: the measurement that would settle it sits in a figure we refused to digitise
joint.what_actually_follows: The claim that we can DESIGN an organism is not supported by this validation, and the reason is not that the design scored badly: it is that the design is not measurable on the axes that define it, and the one genetic number that can be computed (1/74) says the design reproduces a single convergent locus out of everything known to differ. Dropping the claim outright under rule 1 overstates what this gate can tell us; the honest position is PREREG rule 2, drop the claim as UNSUPPORTED.

ratio.definition: Minimal parameter count = 4 per gene (items a-d: absolute abundance, protein half-life, mRNA half-life, transcription rate) + 1 strength per edge of the edge list we could actually assemble.

lenient_variant.what_is_relaxed: item (a) satisfied by a PaxDb ppm value in any whole-organism or organ dataset, ignoring the cell type, the stage and the unit

extended_variant.what_is_added: items e, f, g as well: kinetics, diffusion, cooperativity, one each per gene, so 7 per gene plus one per edge

headline.one_sentence: Of the 18,733 numbers a minimal dynamical model of these 4,571 genes would need, we hold 0, because the eight parameter classes a simulation runs on are not what any of the queried databases stores for zebrafish.
headline.generous_caveat: and all 2972 of those are PaxDb ppm values, a share of total protein mass in a whole organism or a dissected organ, not a count per cell in a named cell type at a named stage
headline.annotation_for_contrast: 3857 of 4571 genes (84.4%) carry a functional annotation

mutations.parallelNote: The compiles are independent, so they run in a pool of 2. The cap is memory, not cores: each lean process holds several GB with Mathlib imported. lake env lean type-checks a copy outside the package, writing no .olean, and each compile also has its own directory under the scratch root, so none can clobber another. lean's own elaboration threads are capped at 16 per compile (LEAN_NUM_THREADS) so the pool does not oversubscribe 32 cores; wall clock against summed compile time is the speedup.

refutations.claim: The tetrapod AER/mesenchyme feedback loop runs on Fgf AND Wnt signals in both directions in the zebrafish pectoral fin.
AER Fgf8/Fgf24 signal back to the mesenchyme to maintain mesenchymal fgf10 expression, as in mouse and chick.
The ZPA is the source of anteroposterior positional information in the zebrafish pectoral fin bud, as Shh is in the tetrapod limb.
Shh from the fin basal epidermis drives proliferation of the underlying skeletal progenitors during ray growth and regeneration.
wnt10a signalling maintains the pectoral fin fold (ZFA:0005317).
HGF/MET is the conserved signal that pulls muscle precursors into the paired fin, so it can be assumed for any fish fin.

pitfalls.title: Ubergraph stores ontology cross-reference values as xsd:string-typed literals, so a SPARQL VALUES block of plain literals matches nothing and returns an empty result with HTTP 200: the same query for the pectoral fin's ZFA cross-reference returned 0 rows with a plain literal and 1 row with a typed literal
Bgee 15.2 and ZFIN's Ensembl 1:1 table use different Ensembl releases, so 1614 zebrafish genes (fgf10a and shha among them) appeared twice under different ids until merged on exact symbol
